element.name: [CT3] Organisational Structure
element.documentation:
Managing parent-child hierarchies, departments, and corporate relationships.
**Overview**
Departments, divisions and regional networks need qualified structural relationships that can be traversed and understood over time. Structural membership is distinct from physical location and from authority to manage another organisation.
**Intent**
Make organisational relationships navigable without confusing structure with ownership or physical containment.
**Boundary**
Structural relationships do not acquire ownership of every related organisation or service.

element.name: Operational Recovery - Requirements
element.documentation:
This existing element is a **SolutionFacet**, a specialisation of native **Grouping**. The [governed definition](../../governance/continuum-representation.md#solutionfacet-classification--1119-candidate) distinguishes accessible solution classification from Capability, responsibility and ownership. Its canonical identity, G01–G18 context, existing Composition and separately established Home assertions are preserved.
Native Grouping originally authored as `Resilience-and-Recovery.Operational-Recovery.Requirements` in the retained 004 export, incorporated under the Solution Architect's Subject Grouping hierarchy Task. It groups the source-qualified `Requirements` concern within the existing **Operational Recovery** SolutionFacet (G07.03). Its earlier authored name above is retained as provenance; current names follow the explicit properties in the 1.1.19 submission. That earlier incoming record has no Documentation or authored Properties; no normative definition, native statement, classification of individual statements, or additional responsibility is invented to complete that absence.
The Task explicitly establishes parent-to-child Composition as containment and a separate directed child-to-parent Home Association as authoritative architectural location. These are distinct assertions. Neither diagram membership nor the Grouping's label alone establishes another Home or a statement allocation. No component ownership, implementation dependency, Capability decomposition, new Motivation statement or OpenSpec candidate incorporation is conferred.
Source Exchange identifier: `id-4894c257f0bb4e0780794d0f7e6fd208`. View placement corroborates the authorised containing SolutionFacet; the exact correspondence is retained in the iteration's folder/Grouping inventories. Existing canonical identities and all pre-existing architectural assertions retain their standing. Archi visual acceptance and HCRL closure remain separate.

element.documentation:
Validate that a practitioner possesses active credentials and required competency certs prior to dispatching specialized work.

element.name: Mneme
element.documentation:
### Approved 1.1.24 incorporation — resulting candidate pending
Two internal cache responsibilities separate distributed lightweight **Mneme-Standard-Cache** (Infinispan Server/Hot Rod) from materialised **Mneme-Workflow-Cache** (embedded Infinispan LOCAL in applicable execution JVMs). Cache manifestations/generations remain the same governed IUs and confer no durable authority. Mneme retains active state/concurrency and governs population/refresh/eviction. Common Ergon retains load/unload/checkpoint/recovery. Framework loading may independently materialise immutable input through full Reader; workflow copies are not replicated.
The upper persistence interaction exposes exactly GovernedSummaryReader, GovernedSummaryWriter(CREATE, RETIRE), GovernedSummarySearch, GovernedReader and GovernedWriter. These refine persistence-facing roles and do not add to Mneme's four principal consumer services. Historical GovernedSearch references below identify the predecessor role now refined as sole GovernedSummarySearch. Summary is IU minus Content; full writes establish coherent Content/reference/Summary, full reads attempt materialisation. Summary registration of external Content performs no external verification; external Content is SEP.
The consumer cache/wait choices, exact-version integrity, complete required capability coverage, origin-bound continuation, authoritative version=* uncertain-write reconciliation and multi-site Success contracts are defined in the linked services/Store. Cache success/replication never proves authoritative durability. API names/defaults, topology, proof and technical MC-01–MC-07 obligations remain qualified, including two-site post-loss new-write impossibility. Raw Hot Rod/local cache access is not a public alternative to Mneme governance.
### Accepted Mnemosyne collaboration allocation — 1.1.23/001
Mneme performs the Mnemosyne Adapter (Store) responsibility for TopicMask capability discovery, eligible-instance selection, load balancing and availability/changeover. Individual IU concurrency, active governed management and consumer-facing search/disclosure/Search Result Sets remain Mneme’s responsibilities. Multiple Mnemosyne instances may concurrently process distinct IUs of one type, but the same IU resolves to one logical authoritative engine and is subject to Mneme’s concurrency control. Provider-native version, authoritative durable version, Mneme operational Version and Active Generation remain distinct under accepted 1.1.22 semantics.
Mnemosyne reports persistence Outcome; Mneme chooses its subsequent disposition without rewriting factual status. Changeover does not prove an in-flight write failed or authorise blind retry. Mechanisms remain solution design; this creates no distributed coordination framework or implementation/module boundary.
### Accepted Information Unit Framework incorporation — 1.1.22
Mneme manages active [InformationUnits](../data-object/class/74ec609de1ae498fbf9d13e4ef8c6cbe.md) and their Metadata.ManagementContext. Operational Version handles cache conflicts/staleness; Active Generation identifies a successfully established individual manifestation, with multiple generations per operational Version permitted. Embedded, referenced, hybrid and explicitly transient working metadata grant no durable authority or client write permission. AX-05 convergence/generation guardrails remain binding. Mneme validates creator/updater-supplied local references under their governed contract and preserves remote references without validating external targets. GovernedReader, GovernedWriter and GovernedSearch denote the IU-level boundary roles described by the accepted DRP; they do not allocate additional exposed Services/interfaces or replace the existing four principal Mneme services. Alternative governed transformations remain client business logic producing new IUs. No automatic backlink/relationship repair, synchronisation or universal lifecycle is added.
- **Role/responsibility:** **Harmonia's Context and Pragma Manager**. Mneme manages the information context of activity through Pragma/Context, providing controlled, concurrent and seamless access to existing values and management of new Content. [U10](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/sources.md#u10) refines AX-05/11 active representation/coordination. - **Principal exposed services:** **Context Load, Context Save, Adhoc Resource Access, Adhoc Search** — four services. [Lifecycle](49c9eb2bef0c47b8b5328621d5fc5479.md) distinguishes Mneme materialisation/save from Ergo Loader/Unloader boundaries. Likely resource sets are non-exhaustive; bounded runtime acquisition is supported. - **Internal responsibilities:** Pragma Management C28 retains PragmaFactory and Publishing/Subscription/Pattern semantic eligibility/selection. Context management composes authoritative resource values into a versioned temporal snapshot; Resource Harmonisation Manager C40 manages exceptional delivery conditions. C11 supporting contracts do not add exposed services. - **Information:** Context D26 is the working value environment; Pragma C07 is the input/output envelope. Changed Context values and new Content expressed as Pragma Output D28 remain distinct. Mneme manages their subsequent consequences. - **Persistence:** active state is reconstructable; Mnemosyne alone establishes durable state and authoritatively reports persistence outcomes. Working changes, cache retention/replication and output production confer no durable authority. Context/resource versions and active generation remain distinct. - **Collaboration/exclusions:** Ergo framework anticipates/loads; Ergon primarily acts on Context values and may acquire Adhoc information. Resource harmonisation uses new governed Harmonisation Ergon work through common Ponos execution, not originating-Ergon conflict resolution. Adhoc Search uses Mnemosyne Search Management. Petasos retains handoff; Themis owns enforcement. Mneme is not a generic repository, execution framework, durable version authority or raw database/cache access path. - **Standing:** U10 adjudicates Context/Pragma responsibility; detailed representation, concurrency/access/Output and harmonisation contracts remain CDG-45/46; older cache/write-behind and access variants remain CDG-10/11/16/27/31.
### Candidate amendment — Post-creation cache availability
Mneme SHALL interpret and apply `Cache{InformationUnit}.postCreateAvailability` within its managed cache environment. This architectural property governs the required post-creation availability behaviour of an [InformationUnit](../data-object/class/74ec609de1ae498fbf9d13e4ef8c6cbe.md). Its permitted enumeration values and semantics are exactly:
| Value | Architectural semantics | | --- | --- | | `Immediate-And-Distributed` | Following creation, the InformationUnit is immediately materialised in the originating Mneme cache and proactively distributed across the applicable cache environment. | | `Immediate` | Following creation, the InformationUnit is immediately materialised in the originating Mneme cache without requiring proactive distribution. | | `OnRequest` | The InformationUnit is durably persisted without requiring proactive cache materialisation or distribution. Materialisation occurs on demand through governed retrieval. |
For **all three values**:
- [Mnemosyne](7985e647bf9e4ca3ba70faf9e3e4ae02.md) establishes and reports authoritative durable persistence and retains authoritative versioning and persistence-outcome responsibility. - Information remains accessible through existing governed retrieval and search mechanisms. `OnRequest` means **on-demand materialisation**, not delayed persistence or delayed accessibility. Mnemosyne's existing Search Management searches authoritative managed persistence without assuming that transient caches contain the complete searchable information space. - Cache materialisation and distribution do not establish durable persistence authority. Mneme active-state generation and authoritative durable versions retain their existing distinct meanings. - The policy does not redefine InformationUnit identity, versioning, lifecycle or governance, or weaken durability, reliability, recovery, security or authorisation obligations. Existing audit and Assurance boundaries remain intact.
This policy is an architectural requirement in Mneme's existing responsibility boundary. It establishes no new principal Mneme service, Mnemosyne persistence mechanism, storage subsystem, implementation technology or deployment arrangement. The notation and enumeration describe an architectural policy, not a new Class, API, implementation enum or selected runtime value.
**Unresolved determination and implementation:** A value supplied with an individual creation operation and a value derived from governing information metadata remain possible approaches. Neither is selected, and no precedence rule, default, timing threshold, replication topology, cache implementation, API or additional enumeration value is established. Provenance is a natural candidate for `OnRequest`; this does not mandate that value for every Provenance instance.
**Standing and preserved qualifications:** The bounded follow-up Task records component-level review recommendations, not formal candidate acceptance. This amendment awaits consolidated Solution Architect review under HCRL 1.1.19-001 DR-18/DR-19. Original candidate contributions and all six earlier unresolved questions remain: original versus linked new retry Pragma; execution-attempt representation; synchronous/asynchronous Provenance publication; publication acknowledgement/recovery; detailed Provenance schemas/cardinalities/lifecycle states; detailed client-library contracts/deployment. The cache policy does not resolve publication timing, durable acknowledgement, retry or recovery contracts.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/context-and-persistence-management.md` — ## Mneme — Context and Pragma Manager. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
> **Mneme manages the information context of Harmonia activity — principally > through Pragma and Context — providing controlled, concurrent and seamless > access to existing resource values and management of the new Content produced > by that activity.**
Mneme is Harmonia's **Context and Pragma Manager**. Distributed active representation, observation, coordination, reconstruction and convergence support this responsibility under AX-05/11; they do not make Mneme a generic repository or persistence authority. Pragma Management retains its adjudicated PragmaFactory and Publishing/Subscription/Pattern responsibilities. Semantic selection remains distinct from Petasos handoff and Ponos execution.
Mneme exposes **four principal services**:
| Exposed service | Architectural meaning | | :--- | :--- | | **Context Load** | Materialise a managed Context from authoritative resource values for anticipated activity requirements. | | **Context Save** | Return resulting Context state to Mneme management for appropriate subsequent information handling, alongside distinguishable Pragma Outputs. | | **Adhoc Resource Access** | Governed runtime acquisition of resource information outside the anticipated loaded Context where the bounded activity requires it. | | **Adhoc Search** | Activity/context-facing governed search, using Mnemosyne's underlying authoritative persistence Search Management. |
Resource Harmonisation Manager is an **internal responsibility**, not a fifth exposed service. Historical read/write facades and supporting contracts are not additional principal services; their detailed relationship to this surface remains unresolved. No additional exposed Mneme services are established here.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/context-and-persistence-management.md` — ## Retained uncertainty and existing adjudications. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
[CDG-45–48](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/gaps.md#context-and-pragma-contracts) retain the new detailed gaps: Context and access representation/concurrency, exceptional harmonisation, persistence oversight/compartments/outcome contracts, and Search/Research Metadata. Transaction boundaries, rollback/retry, shard routing/topology/replication, service-health metrics, semantic compartment-applicability source, compartment representation/validation, PEP interaction and logging schemas remain unresolved.
Kleio essential capture/immutable history and cross-target harmonisation SEP, Themis distributed enforcement/default-deny, Petasos queues/Parcel/handoff, Energeia Praxis/Journey ownership, DigitalTwin/Dokimasia specialisations and terminal rules, and Pathway/control/observed-evidence distinctions are preserved. Kleio's [mandatory capture authority](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/component-register.md#kleio-capture-authority) is intrinsic platform authority governed by Harmonia policy under AX-07. The audited Identity is evidence, not capture authority. Insufficient capture authority fails the governed operation closed; Mneme/Mnemosyne gain no equivalent authority. Those A2/A3 corrections did not themselves establish A4 acceptance. Current A4 acceptance and the bounded B1 scope are recorded in the [orientation](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/README.md).

## Candidate ADD — Provenance Management and Assurance
Provenance is governed information managed through Mneme using existing governed information-management mechanisms. Dokimasia retains Provenance Management framework and lifecycle ownership; Mnemosyne establishes authoritative durable state/persistence. This adds no principal service, generic repository role, raw cache/database access path or independent Provenance store. Existing identity/version/reference/governance semantics and reliability/durability/timeliness requirements remain in force. Publication timing, acknowledgement/recovery, schemas/cardinalities/lifecycle states and client-library details remain unresolved; no transport or API is selected.
Agreed intent is recorded in the operative ADD Task; this contribution awaits explicit Solution Architect candidate acceptance under HCRL 1.1.19-001 DR-18/DR-19. Prior definitions, assertion standing and unresolved detailed-design matters are preserved.
Canonical ADD references: [Provenance](../data-object/e282811b51274649816566aac7edeb8a.md); [Provenance Client Library](171f05d188384cedb7d5c493eeaee519.md).

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Quality Evidence Management
element.documentation:
Manage the body of applicable evidence used for clinical-quality consideration without owning its originating activity.
Clinical Quality Evidence Management maintains the body of material applicable to quality consideration. Its purpose is to retain evidence in a form and context that can support review without treating availability as proof of quality. The originating activity and its authority remain distinguishable from the later quality purpose for which its information is used.
**Boundary**
Evidentiary use transfers neither source ownership nor authority to determine the activity being reviewed.

element.name: [CT3] Assurance Evidence Assessment
element.documentation:
Evaluate available evidence against the established assurance approach and criteria.
Assurance Evidence Assessment evaluates available evidence against the established approach and criteria. It produces the assessed basis from which a legitimate conclusion may be determined, retaining qualifications and evidentiary limits. The responsibility is evaluative rather than the operational production of the source information or remediation of what it reveals.
**Boundary**
Assessment is distinct from conclusion determination; unavailable or insufficient evidence must remain explicit.

element.name: [CT3] Assurance Criteria Administration
element.documentation:
The capability to establish and manage reusable, governed and temporally identifiable assurance criteria through which subjects may be evaluated.
Definition — reviewed candidate
Administer reusable governed assurance criteria and their version-specific and temporal applicability without changing governing requirement authority.
**Overview**
Administer reusable governed assurance criteria and their version-specific and temporal applicability without changing governing requirement authority.
**Intent**
Administer reusable governed assurance criteria and their version-specific and temporal applicability without changing governing requirement authority.
**Boundary**
Information administration does not confer authority over the represented person, organisation, service, place, device or clinical activity.
---
## History
### Capability Overview — predecessor explanation
Assurance Criteria Management maintains reusable evaluative criteria with governed standing and temporal applicability. Version and effective context matter because a conclusion must be understood against the criteria applicable to the subject and time being assessed. Criteria may operationalise governing requirements, but their management is not authority to change those requirements.
### Boundary — predecessor explanation
Modelling criteria does not inherently approve them. Detailed criterion states and approval workflows remain unresolved, and criteria need not all originate in formal Governance.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Formal relevance remains Unresolved. Established assurance support explains the enabling purpose without classifying it by inference or allocating software responsibility.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: Healthcare Directory Stewards & Registrars
element.documentation:
### Profile & Role Healthcare Directory Stewards and Registrars are the specialized operational custodians responsible for maintaining authoritative regional registries of healthcare providers, individual clinicians, clinical organizations, and electronic service delivery endpoints.
### Core Responsibilities - Curating authoritative master directories of healthcare practitioners, qualifications, active credentials, and organizational affiliations. - Verifying and maintaining electronic service delivery endpoints (secure messaging addresses, FHIR endpoints, MLLP port mappings). - Managing provider registry updates, deprecations, practitioner relocations, and retirement events.
### Principal Architectural Concerns - **Secure Endpoint Governance**: Ensuring clinical messages and notifications are routed exclusively to authenticated, currently authorized practitioner endpoints. - **Accurate Practitioner Role Representation**: Distinguishing between an individual clinician, their legal practitioner role, their accredited specialty, and their specific institutional practice location. - **Reliable Directory Change Propagation**: Ensuring directory updates (e.g., changes in clinic address or revocation of practitioner credentials) propagate through integration workflows rapidly and deterministically.

The [governed definition](../../governance/continuum-representation.md#solutionfacet-classification--1119-candidate) distinguishes accessible solution classification from Capability, responsibility and ownership. Its canonical identity, G01–G18 context, existing Composition and separately established Home assertions are preserved.
Native Grouping originally authored as `Security-and-Authorisation.Information-Protection.Principles` in the retained 004 export, incorporated under the Solution Architect's Subject Grouping hierarchy Task. It groups the source-qualified `Principles` concern within the existing **Information Protection** SolutionFacet (G03.04). Its earlier authored name above is retained as provenance; current names follow the explicit properties in the 1.1.19 submission. That earlier incoming record has no Documentation or authored Properties; no normative definition, native statement, classification of individual statements, or additional responsibility is invented to complete that absence.
The Task explicitly establishes parent-to-child Composition as containment and a separate directed child-to-parent Home Association as authoritative architectural location. These are distinct assertions. Neither diagram membership nor the Grouping's label alone establishes another Home or a statement allocation. No component ownership, implementation dependency, Capability decomposition, new Motivation statement or OpenSpec candidate incorporation is conferred.
Source Exchange identifier: `id-0a17b369762e45d0bc20fd3bdf155783`. View placement corroborates the authorised containing SolutionFacet; the exact correspondence is retained in the iteration's folder/Grouping inventories. Existing canonical identities and all pre-existing architectural assertions retain their standing. Archi visual acceptance and HCRL closure remain separate.

element.name: [Feature] Referral Document Ingestion
element.documentation:
Ingest structured clinical referral messages across integration boundaries.
Referral ingestion establishes the received referral material within the integration boundary. It preserves the request for another participant's involvement without treating successful receipt as clinical acceptance, responsibility assumption or a promise that care will be delivered.

element.name: [Topic] TaskDefinition
element.documentation:
**Description** Information defining a reusable form of actionable work, including the characteristics, expectations and constraints applicable when instances of that work are created.
**ActionableTaskArchetype** is the reusable definition/archetype for a kind of actionable work. It describes the meaning and constraints of work that may subsequently be instantiated. It SHALL NOT be treated as an instance of work.
Its semantics may include, where applicable:
- the expected nature of the work; - permissible parameters and constraints; - prerequisites and performer requirements; - completion or satisfaction expectations; and - expectations concerning information/content consumed, manipulated or produced by the work.
An archetype may establish expectations concerning encapsulated content without defining that content's structural representation or requiring Harmonia to comprehend its domain semantics. The [observable-information boundary](../../../business/business-object/10284034c8534b639284386b064f2c54.md) applies.
Source standing: Bounded adjudicated conceptual Task meaning; section 5 reservations, including runtime TaskOutcome identity/lifecycle, remain unresolved.

element.name: Statutory Health Information Privacy & Protection
element.documentation:
### Context & Pressure Health records contain the most sensitive category of personal data recognized under law (medical histories, psychiatric evaluations, sexual health diagnoses, genetic profiles). Healthcare networks are subject to rigorous statutory privacy regimes (e.g., the Australian *Privacy Act 1988*, My Health Records Act, HIPAA, GDPR).
Statutory authorities enforce severe civil penalties, mandatory breach reporting, and reputational sanctions for unauthorized disclosure, eavesdropping, or accidental data leakage.
### Architectural Imperative Harmonia must implement intrinsic, default-deny security and privacy controls across all operations. Sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI) must never be emitted into non-clinical logging streams, telemetry systems, or debug channels. Access must require explicit cryptographic authentication and fine-grained authorization.
- **Primary Stakeholders**: [Patients & Care Recipients](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/stakeholders/enterprise-stakeholders.md), [Platform Operations & Integration Engineers](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/stakeholders/enterprise-stakeholders.md) - **External Constraint**: [Applicable Health-Information Privacy and Data-Protection Obligations](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/requirements-constraints/external-constraints.md) - **Key Assessments**: [Implicit Perimeter Trust](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/drivers-assessments/assessments.md), [PHI Leakage through Operational Logging](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/drivers-assessments/assessments.md) - **Governing Axioms**: [AX-07 (Security Is Intrinsic to Managed Operations)](../principle/architectural-axiom/5de2ae2c3b794c2d9f3a14efd51d564f.md), [AX-08 (Evidence Records Meaning)](../principle/21d6864657964ba5b03e3f6b5eb29cd5.md)

element.name: [CT3] Information Model Governance Oversight
element.documentation:
Oversee and evaluate effectiveness, consistency and appropriate operation of information-model governance.
This capability evaluates the effectiveness and consistency of information-model governance itself. It asks whether discovery, adoption and use are being governed appropriately, rather than repeating each operational peer. Its purpose is coherent oversight of the arrangements that give models standing and guide their application.
**Boundary**
Oversight does not itself perform discovery, adoption, education or compliance activities.
## Capability model replacement history

Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: Operational Diagnostics - Principles
element.documentation:
This existing element is a **SolutionFacet**, a specialisation of native **Grouping**. The [governed definition](../../governance/continuum-representation.md#solutionfacet-classification--1119-candidate) distinguishes accessible solution classification from Capability, responsibility and ownership. Its canonical identity, G01–G18 context, existing Composition and separately established Home assertions are preserved.
Native Grouping originally authored as `Operations-and-Assurance.Operational-Diagnostics.Principles` in the retained 004 export, incorporated under the Solution Architect's Subject Grouping hierarchy Task. It groups the source-qualified `Principles` concern within the existing **Operational Diagnostics** SolutionFacet (G09.02). Its earlier authored name above is retained as provenance; current names follow the explicit properties in the 1.1.19 submission. That earlier incoming record has no Documentation or authored Properties; no normative definition, native statement, classification of individual statements, or additional responsibility is invented to complete that absence.
The Task explicitly establishes parent-to-child Composition as containment and a separate directed child-to-parent Home Association as authoritative architectural location. These are distinct assertions. Neither diagram membership nor the Grouping's label alone establishes another Home or a statement allocation. No component ownership, implementation dependency, Capability decomposition, new Motivation statement or OpenSpec candidate incorporation is conferred.
Source Exchange identifier: `id-dd037a51d1654576929f4e74244bf9ca`. View placement corroborates the authorised containing SolutionFacet; the exact correspondence is retained in the iteration's folder/Grouping inventories. Existing canonical identities and all pre-existing architectural assertions retain their standing. Archi visual acceptance and HCRL closure remain separate.

element.documentation:

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Quality Criteria Management
element.documentation:
Establish and manage measures, indicators, expectations and criteria against which clinical quality is considered.
Clinical Quality Criteria Management establishes the measures, indicators and expectations used to consider clinical quality. It makes the basis of a later judgement explicit so that evidence can be assessed against an identifiable expectation rather than an unstated standard. Criteria are distinct from the measurements or findings produced when they are applied.
**Boundary**
Managing criteria does not originate the underlying evidence or establish a quality conclusion.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [7a51321b00464016920976b269981edd](7a51321b00464016920976b269981edd.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). Primary replacement catalogue identity `B11.03.01`; additional scope correspondences: `B11.04`. Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [Feature] Operational Capacity Metric Aggregation
element.documentation:
Aggregate operational capacity telemetry (occupancy rates, wait times, diversion status) across facilities.
Capacity aggregation combines occupancy, waiting and diversion context across facilities. The higher-order view must retain the originating service-specific capacity meaning; a shared metric does not transfer clinic, ward or theatre capacity responsibility to the aggregator.
## Capability model replacement history

Primary replacement catalogue identity `E09.02.01`; additional scope correspondences: `B07.03.02`. Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.documentation:
Manage organisational communication/publication arrangements relevant to information availability/distribution.
Communications & Publicity manages organisational publication and communication arrangements relevant to information availability and distribution. element.name: [CT1] Health Service Governance
element.documentation:
Establish and maintain the obligations, authorities, constraints, policies and governance framework under which health-service activity must operate, and define how adherence will be assessed, checked and reported.
Health Service Governance establishes the normative envelope within which health-service activity operates: what obligations apply, who may decide, what constraints bind decisions and how adherence will be assessed and reported. Its framework and compliance branches distinguish the authoritative requirements from the arrangements used to judge satisfaction. Governance therefore shapes legitimate activity without becoming the manager of every governed operation.
**Intent**
Make obligations, decision authority and compliance expectations explicit and traceable.
**Boundary**
Operational management chooses and progresses means within the governing envelope; assurance evaluates evidence. Neither responsibility is absorbed merely because governance defines its constraints.
**Harmonia Architectural Relevance**
Formal relevance remains Unresolved. The requirements plainly constrain managed activity, but the RAD has not assigned enough platform participation or enabling derivation to adjudicate its relevance classification.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: [CT2] Outpatient Operations
element.documentation:
Outpatient Operations integrates arrival events and follow-up requirements generated as clinics progress. It connects a person's operational presence with the relevant service context and makes post-clinic booking or diagnostic needs available for subsequent activity. The responsibility retains outpatient-specific capacity semantics without requiring a separate arrival Function where approved reusable composition suffices.
**Overview**
Outpatient Operations integrates arrival events and follow-up requirements generated as clinics progress. It connects a person's operational presence with the relevant service context and makes post-clinic booking or diagnostic needs available for subsequent activity. The responsibility retains outpatient-specific capacity semantics without requiring a separate arrival Function where approved reusable composition suffices.
**Intent**
Outpatient Operations integrates arrival events and follow-up requirements generated as clinics progress. It connects a person's operational presence with the relevant service context and makes post-clinic booking or diagnostic needs available for subsequent activity. The responsibility retains outpatient-specific capacity semantics without requiring a separate arrival Function where approved reusable composition suffices.
**Boundary**
Information administration does not confer authority over the represented person, organisation, service, place, device or clinical activity.
---
## History
### Boundary — predecessor explanation
An arrival does not establish consultation completion, and a captured follow-up requirement does not perform the clinical activity.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Arrival and clinic-outcome information materially connect outpatient progression to care coordination.

**Boundary**
Administrative interaction grants no raw cache/database or subsystem-internal bypass.

element.name: AX-08 Evidence Records Meaning, Not Machinery
element.documentation:
#### Axiom
Provenance and audit evidence SHALL describe information-significant, security-significant and business-significant events, assertions and decisions.
Internal implementation mechanics SHALL NOT ordinarily become provenance or audit evidence merely because they occurred.
#### Rationale
A durable evidence repository should explain what happened to information and why, rather than become a permanent distributed debug log.
#### Consequences
Authoritative state acceptance, significant information transformations, stewardship decisions and security-significant actions MAY require durable evidence.
Cache misses, cache rebalancing, CAS retries, connection retries, reconstruction and ordinary infrastructure mechanics normally belong in logging, metrics or transient diagnostics.
Kleio preserves durable evidence.
#### Maxim
Preserve the meaningful fact, not every mechanism that produced it.

element.name: Coordinated Progression of Operational Activities and Associated Entity State
element.documentation:
### Goal Statement Harmonia shall coordinate multi-stage operational activities through explicit, observable state transitions that remain strictly synchronized with the governed state of the associated real-world clinical entity.
### Rationale & Context Healthcare integration activities (such as ADT distribution, lab order dispatch, and multi-destination fan-out) involve multi-stage distributed operations. Treating integration simply as a stream of fire-and-forget message transfers causes destination divergence and unmonitored failures (as diagnosed in [Unmonitored Destination Failure](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/drivers-assessments/assessments.md)).
### Architectural Boundary & Intent - **Beyond Conventional Workflow Engines**: Avoid language implying that Harmonia is merely a generic workflow engine. Harmonia does not simply execute arbitrary BPMN scripts; it coordinates distributed integration activities in lockstep with the real-world lifecycle of clinical entities (e.g., patient admission state, lab specimen lifecycle, encounter status). - Requires explicit, observable progression state across multi-stage activities ([`REQ-FND-002`](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/requirements-constraints/foundational-requirements.md)). - Governed by [AX-16 (Operational Activity & Entity State Progress Together)](../principle/de7e90f46127455a9ec9ad3b9b48ba54.md).

element.name: Mneme Adapter / Façade
element.documentation:
### Approved 1.1.24 incorporation — resulting candidate pending
Participate in exactly five upper contracts: GovernedSummaryReader, GovernedSummaryWriter(CREATE, RETIRE), GovernedSummarySearch, GovernedReader and GovernedWriter. SummarySearch refines the existing Search identity; the five-tier internal allocation is unchanged. Register this configured instance's SupportedIU-Criterion using shared TopicMasks; Mneme Store owns RequiredIU-Criterion discovery/selection and complete required coverage checks, independently of Themis. Registration covers the five logical contracts, not uniform native search support. Preserve factual Outcome, same-IU coherence, opaque reference/Content separation, multi-site mutation completion and original-instance continuation. These contracts transfer no cache management to Mnemosyne.
------- Legacy Content - Superseded ------- Start ------ Superseded by: 1.1.24 contract refinement below; enterprise-architecture/design/review/1.1.24/hcrl-1.1.24-001.pending.md#dr-1. Only the enclosed predecessor wording is superseded; source history is unchanged. ---------------------------------------------------------
Mnemosyne's first responsibility tier participates in Interaction::Mneme-to-Mnemosyne through GovernedReader, GovernedWriter and GovernedSearch. It receives governed requests and conveys persistence information and Outcomes; Mneme owns subsequent consumer disposition. ------- Legacy Content - Superseded ------- Finish ----
Each Mnemosyne instance's Façade registers its supported IU-type capabilities through the established Topic mechanism. Registrations may be identical, overlapping or disjoint across instances and may cover multiple IU types. This is capability declaration, not IU-instance ownership or evidence of current availability. Mneme's Mnemosyne Adapter (Store), a different responsibility, discovers registrations with the shared TopicMask primitive.
The Façade preserves the relationship to the IU UUID/Topic, applicable versions and operation/stage Outcome. It does not expose a raw provider database as Harmonia's application path. No protocol, registration registry, implementation interface, call stack or deployment boundary is prescribed.
### Incorporation standing
Accepted parent DRP semantics, incorporated under the operative Task for 1.1.23/001. Actual resulting candidate confirmation remains pending. Earlier component/source qualifications remain independently in force.

element.documentation:
Identify and track operational and infrastructure dependencies necessary for clinical services to function, including care-place and environmental readiness, devices, materiel, forms, workstations, connectivity, infrastructure and basic working materials.
**Overview**
Identify and track operational and infrastructure dependencies necessary for clinical services to function, including care-place and environmental readiness, devices, materiel, forms, workstations, connectivity, infrastructure and basic working materials. The reviewed hierarchy assigns this enduring ability to its stated business-enabling context.
**Intent**
Identify and track operational and infrastructure dependencies necessary for clinical services to function, including care-place and environmental readiness, devices, materiel, forms, workstations, connectivity, infrastructure and basic working materials.
**Boundary**
Information administration and coordination preserve the authority of the responsible source, clinical actor and governed domain; they confer no additional real-world management authority.

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Device Feature & Release Management
element.documentation:
Manage functional/release state, including applicable software, firmware, configuration and enabled device characteristics.
This capability governs the functional state of a device, including applicable software, firmware, configuration and enabled characteristics. Two instances of the same model may therefore have materially different capabilities in service. The responsibility makes those differences intelligible without reducing device governance to physical inventory or location.
**Boundary**
Release state is distinct from maintenance condition, deployment and professional authority to use the device.
## Capability model replacement history

element.name: [CT2] Emergency Department Operations
element.documentation:
This capability maintains the operational context of emergency places, waits and length-of-stay milestones. It supports understanding of occupancy and impediments in the department while keeping capacity's emergency-service meaning intact. Its concern differs from Emergency Care's clinical presentation context, even though both can refer to the same patient encounter.
**Overview**
This capability maintains the operational context of emergency places, waits and length-of-stay milestones. It supports understanding of occupancy and impediments in the department while keeping capacity's emergency-service meaning intact. Its concern differs from Emergency Care's clinical presentation context, even though both can refer to the same patient encounter.
**Intent**
This capability maintains the operational context of emergency places, waits and length-of-stay milestones. It supports understanding of occupancy and impediments in the department while keeping capacity's emergency-service meaning intact. Its concern differs from Emergency Care's clinical presentation context, even though both can refer to the same patient encounter.
**Boundary**
Information administration does not confer authority over the represented person, organisation, service, place, device or clinical activity.
---

Operational timing and escalation do not determine triage or acquire clinical decision authority.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Care-place state and operational waiting information materially support coordination of the emergency service.

element.name: AI Assurance Architecture Discovery Before Implementation
element.documentation:
Domain05 must undertake explicit Information Systems Layer Architecture discovery before implementation models are finalised, including: AI model/service selection and abstraction; context/input construction; information disclosure/security; model/service provenance and versioning; confidence/uncertainty/result representation; deterministic versus non-deterministic behaviour; reproducibility; result validation; human review/escalation; assurance evidence representation; workflow integration; failure/timeout/unavailability behaviour; and reporting/observability consistent with Dokimasia's terminal-boundary rules.
This assertion is normalised from the governed DesignNote under U02/U06/U19 and the ARB release Praxis. Original candidate/release qualifications and separately deferred implementation details remain in force.
Architectural subject: [Energeia](../../application/application-component/fb3f37a6ac614415ac486a6de9d35994.md).

element.name: [UserStory] Downstream systems maintain consistent patient information
element.documentation:
Independent stakeholder need, expectation or desired outcome:
> Receive the authoritative patient identity record so that downstream systems maintain consistent patient information.
The need is independently identifiable. It may encompass interactions, governance, human and organisational activity beyond any associated UseCase. Successful execution of associated interactions does not establish satisfaction of this need.
### Reconciled source contributions
- `UC-Integration-Identity-9` — Receive Golden Patient Identity; Scope - Identity Matching and Resolution; [source](../../../../../openspec/specs/patient-identity-management/uc-integration-identity-9-receive-golden-patient-identity/spec.md).
Source-specific access conditions, supporting actors, alternative outcomes, verification and data-authority rules remain distinct in their cited source contributions. Legacy claims that each statement is a business capability are not adopted: this instance has native Requirement semantics. Source target-state scope is not a software delivery commitment for 1.1.21. Historical assessment findings remain recoverable and do not establish current coverage.

element.name: [Feature] Theatre Session Capacity Management
element.documentation:
Represent available and committed procedural-session capacity with its resource dependencies.
**Overview**
Theatre capacity involves session time, team capability, equipment and recovery provision rather than a count of theatres.
**Boundary**
Local responsibility retains its capacity meaning; Service Capacity Management consumes it without acquiring ownership or imposing one common capacity model.
## Capability model replacement history

element.name: Boundary Membrane Sovereignty
element.documentation:
#### Strategic Approach > **Preserve strict separation between external standards-compliant exchange representations and internal Harmonia-governed operational semantics.**
Harmonia acts as an integration environment bridging heterogeneous external healthcare systems and internal integration services. This course of action establishes that: - External exchange contracts (such as FHIR REST interactions, MLLP message streams, or directory protocols) govern only the interaction semantics at the enterprise boundary. - External or standards-based representations MAY remain native Harmonia information representations where appropriate. Their use SHALL NOT cause an external exchange contract or representation to define Harmonia-private management, execution, governance or coordination semantics. - Egress across the boundary terminates Harmonia's governance of the emitted representation.
#### Motivational Grounding & Traceability - **Architectural Axioms**: - `AX-02` (Boundary Membrane): External representations are boundary projections; internal semantics are sovereign. - `AX-03` (Native Standards): Standards govern interoperability at the boundary; standards are not distorted to fit private operational models. - `AX-13` (Explicit Management Boundary): Egress terminates platform management; internal operational metadata does not leak across the boundary. - `AX-14` (Preserve Distinctions): Distinctions between external exchange syntax and internal operational meaning are preserved. - **Strategic Drivers & Goals**: Interoperability Mandates, Vendor Independence, Unified Ingress/Egress Governance.
#### Capability Realisation & Configuration - **Primary Capabilities**: Shapes `EC-08` (Interoperability & Exchange) and `EC-13` (Semantic Governance & Conformance). - **Component Boundary Impact**: Informs the boundary responsibility of **Pylai**, establishing it as the standards-facing membrane rather than an internal processing engine or generic transport layer.
#### Downstream Direction (Domains 03–13) - Application Architecture (Domain 05) and Integration Architecture (Domain 06) must implement fail-closed boundary projections, ensuring private coordination metadata (e.g., distributed transaction IDs, internal routing tags) is never emitted externally. - Information Architecture (Domain 04) preserves conceptual meaning and responsibility independently of external contracts. Native standards representations remain permitted under AX-03; no parallel information model is required merely to accommodate Harmonia-private management concerns.

**Overview**
Manage application of patient health-information restrictions using the client-associated privacy and consent responsibilities retained by Client Privacy Guardrail Management. The reviewed hierarchy assigns this enduring ability to its stated business-enabling context.
**Intent**
Manage application of patient health-information restrictions using the client-associated privacy and consent responsibilities retained by Client Privacy Guardrail Management.
**Boundary**
Information administration and coordination preserve the authority of the responsible source, clinical actor and governed domain; they confer no additional real-world management authority. Client consent directives remain owned by Client Privacy Guardrail Management (FEAT-EM-09); this capability references and respects those determinations without defining a second consent owner.

element.documentation:
**Definition**: A formal, externally governed assertion attesting that a practitioner is registered with a statutory registration board or regulatory authority.
**Description**: Information describing a practitioner's professional registration, including the registering authority, profession, registration status, scope and applicable period.
**Semantic Classification**: `Assertion / Governed Relationship`

element.name: Timely Availability of Clinical Information
element.documentation:
### Goal Statement Harmonia shall make clinical information, event notifications, and diagnostic updates available to care teams and consuming hospital systems within operational latency thresholds appropriate to patient care.
### Rationale & Context Healthcare delivery operates under tight clinical timelines. Point-of-care decisions in emergency departments and intensive care units require rapid turnaround of diagnostic findings. While high throughput is vital, low latency for critical alerts (e.g., life-threatening pathology results) is paramount to prevent diagnostic delays.
### Architectural Boundary - Governs the latency and throughput profile of integration pipelines. - Differentiates between urgent real-time clinical feeds and bulk historical synchronizations. - Hands over directly to [Continuous and Resilient Regional Health Information Exchange (O2)](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/goals-outcomes/business-outcomes.md).

element.name: [CT3] Practitioner Qualification Management
element.documentation:
Govern professional/clinical standing and qualifications, including applicable review, escalation, complaints, penalties/issues, suspension and revocation.
Practitioner Qualification Management governs professional and clinical standing, including review and changes such as suspension or revocation. It makes qualification a continuing governed concern rather than a static directory attribute. That standing can constrain engagement and privilege while remaining distinguishable from either an employment relationship or permission for a particular activity.
**Boundary**
Qualification alone does not establish engagement, clinical privilege, device-specific enablement or operational assignment.

element.name: Pragma Topic
element.documentation:
**Mneme manages Pragma.** Context is the value-based working environment; Pragma is the task/activity information envelope through which inputs and outputs are expressed. They are related and distinct.
**Pragma realises [Metabolē](../../business/business-object/c34b4929f71946708d37dbe6c1da920a.md)** for governed Harmonia information/activity progression. This is architectural Realisation, not synonymy or inheritance from Diadromí. Mneme retains Pragma management; the conceptual construct introduces no common manager, persistence requirement or shared lifecycle with Pylai.Diadromí.
The conceptual [ActivityContext](../../business/business-object/c34b4929f71946708d37dbe6c1da920a.md) classifies the broad activity and is distinct from request action, this loaded Context and Themis PEP-Context. Their detailed physical mapping remains deferred.
An Ergon may read existing Context values, act upon/change working Context values, and generate **new Content**. New Content is expressed as **Pragma Output**, rather than merely an incidental Context mutation:
```text Existing Context values → Ergon → changed working Context values Context + bounded business logic → Ergon → Pragma Output → new Content Context Unloader returns both, distinctly ↓ Mneme manages subsequent information consequences ```
Changed Context values and newly generated Pragma Outputs SHALL remain semantically distinguishable. A working change or produced output does not itself establish authoritative durable state. Task/undertaking/outcome ownership and output rules remain unchanged.
Ergon execution may produce one or more outputs, whose processing may result in multiple Pragma. **Only a Pragma playing the Pathway-continuation role identifies information for continuing the current Praxis along its Pathway**; other resulting Pragma are independently available for governed Pub/Sub, another Praxis, other processing or no further processing. Praxis defines continuation semantics; the execution framework performs applicable output processing and routing, without making Praxis an orchestrator/choreographer or transferring Mneme's information management. See the [shared semantic view](27ad143e7c784e378556af8a57c438f7.md) and [DesignNote](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md). The continuation role creates no subtype. Whether a new Pragma is constructed, an output Pragma is designated, or another governed representation is used remains [explicitly deferred](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/gaps.md#continuation-representation). Exact Output representation, routing mechanisms and Pragma/Information Unit mappings remain open.
Mneme may manage richer resulting Pragma relationships and provenance than the originating Praxis's Journey represents. Continuation lineage supports meaningful Journey progression without making Journey a complete provenance graph, execution log, audit trail or queue history; [Journey's boundary](359b901df27f4b43b5a2ff14a8484e34.md) and Energeia ownership remain intact.
Source standing: Bounded adjudicated application information meaning; Domain05 remains the accepted candidate Step-B baseline, not final Solution Architecture. Detailed representation is deferred; only this defined logical object is projected.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/component-register.md` — ### C07 — Pragma. Standing: Candidate — accepted Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
- **Architectural Realisation:** Pragma realises [Metabolē](../../business/business-object/c34b4929f71946708d37dbe6c1da920a.md) for governed Harmonia information/activity progression. Mneme retains management; this is not synonymy, a common runtime type or a shared lifecycle/persistence contract with Pylai.Diadromí.
- **Role/responsibility:** managed information / Application Data Object under Mneme Pragma Management C28, used for task/context/progression representation. It is not structurally in Energeia merely because execution operates on it. [U01/U02](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/sources.md#u02); [L05/L01/L19](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/sources.md#l05) retain carrier provenance. - **Features/contained constructs:** identity/correlation/causation, inputs/outputs or payload references, context, state/checkpoints, parent association and governed observations concerning destination delivery. Operational handoff/ delivery obligation state belongs to Petasos; exact observation relationships remain unresolved (CDG-18). Every Pragma contains or references a payload such as an Information Unit; metadata/Container/Content distinctions are described in the [semantic shape](27ad143e7c784e378556af8a57c438f7.md). - **Information:** PragmaCheckpoint, ErgonPayload/references, **Pragma Outputs expressing new Content separately from changed Context values**, execution metadata and work-related information. Both ActionableTask and FulfillmentTask have candidate Pragma representation with WorkOrder/ToDo/Stimulus/Effector forms; work instance and undertaking remain distinct. Stimulus and Effector are candidate Pragma specialisations; their schemas/lifecycles remain unknown. Dokimasia also requires candidate Pragma specialisation semantics with assurance request/input and assurance result/finding roles; names, schemas, cardinalities and lifecycle models await adjudication (CDG-09). These specialisations reuse common Pragma process-management, assurance, reporting and other management facilities. They introduce no new Domain04 Information Concepts here. - **Persistence:** relevant Pragma operational information is an O&A classification candidate under U06. Legacy active-cache and FHIR Task/non-FHIR structure variants do not settle detailed history, representation or outcome contracts (CDG-02/03/12/13); the envelope is not authoritative merely by existing. - **Continuation role:** [U18](27ad143e7c784e378556af8a57c438f7.md) distinguishes Pragma independently resulting from Ergon outputs from the Pragma used to continue the current Praxis along its Pathway. Continuation is a role, not a new subtype; construction versus output designation versus another governed representation remains deferred. Independent Pragma may have other governed use or no further processing. Mneme relationships/provenance may exceed the originating Journey's observed progression. - **Collaboration/exclusions:** created/consumed/updated at ingress and execution, observed through presentation and outbound status handling. Does not execute business logic, own pools/consumer loops, define workflow blueprints or convey itself over wire transports. - **Standing:** candidate carrier, not a complete Task/undertaking/outcome model or evidence repository. No universal state machine, automatic context persistence, TaskOutcome schema or ReportedTask meaning is approved here.

## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/pathways-journeys-and-handoff.md` — ## Ergon outputs and the Pathway-continuation role. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
Ergon execution may produce one or more outputs; their processing may result in multiple Pragma. **Not every resulting Pragma advances the current Pathway.** The **Pathway-continuation Pragma** is the role identifying derived information required to continue fulfilment of the current Praxis along its Pathway. Praxis defines derivation semantics; the execution framework performs applicable output processing and routing. Mneme retains management of all resulting Pragma and Context; Petasos retains durable physical handoff where applicable.
Other resulting Pragma remain independently available governed artefacts for Mneme Publish/Subscribe, another Praxis, other governed processing or no further processing. Production alone establishes neither continuation of the current Pathway nor a requirement to publish or consume each output.
**Continuation is a Pragma role, not a new subtype.** Whether continuation always constructs a new Pragma, designates a resulting output Pragma, or uses another governed representation is explicitly deferred. The adjudication and conceptual branching example are in the [DesignNote](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md); [CDG-53](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/gaps.md#continuation-representation) preserves the modelling decision.
**R1.x/R2.x Context requirements remain concretely defined.** Existing likely resource declarations and bounded Adhoc access remain supported. R3.x may introduce criteria-driven dynamic Context determination and dynamically configured reusable/generic Ergo; that direction and its mechanisms remain deferred, with no AI-driven selection/configuration introduced here.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/pathways-journeys-and-handoff.md` — ## Pragma payload and Topic semantics. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
Pragma **realises [Metabolē](../../business/business-object/c34b4929f71946708d37dbe6c1da920a.md)** for governed information/activity progression. The following payload shape retains its application meaning; Realisation neither equates Pragma with the conceptual construct nor requires a shared representation/lifecycle with Diadromí. Mneme retains Pragma management.
Every Pragma contains or references a payload such as an Information Unit. The working semantic shape relevant to Pattern evaluation is:
```text Pragma Pragma Metadata origin / targetDestination / timestamps / processing status / ... Payload (contained or referenced) InformationUnit Container Topic / other metadata (including source) Content Topic / other metadata (including source) ```
This is semantic notation, not a final Java/API/storage schema. “Container” denotes the Unit-level aspect in this application view; it neither reinstates the retired **Information Container** concept nor replaces Domain04's [Identity / Metadata / Content / Context partition](../../../../docs/markdown/04-information-architecture/metamodel/information-architecture-metamodel.md#61-conceptual-partition). Its exact relationship to that partition remains a detailed representation question; Identity and Management Context are not removed by this illustration.
**Topic is governed classification/metadata participating in Pattern evaluation.** It may occur at more than one semantic level. Container Topic and Content Topic need not mean the same thing. Topic is not synonymous with destination, queue or channel; source, origin and targetDestination are not automatically synonyms. Detailed metadata definitions and Container/Content Topic semantics remain unresolved. Neither broker topic naming nor framework routing conventions establish those definitions.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md` — ## 1. Purpose. Standing: Architecturally adjudicated U18; candidate scope and representation deferrals retained.
Distinguish Pragma independently resulting from Ergon execution from the Pragma used to continue fulfilment of the current Praxis along its Pathway. Preserve the corresponding boundary between Journey progression and complete Pragma provenance without prescribing new components or representations.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md` — ## 3. Outputs and continuation. Standing: Architecturally adjudicated U18; candidate scope and representation deferrals retained.
Execution of an Ergon may produce one or more outputs. Processing those outputs may result in multiple Pragma. **Not every resulting Pragma implicitly progresses the current Pathway.**
The **Pathway-continuation Pragma** represents the derived information required to continue fulfilment of the current Praxis along its Pathway. Praxis defines the semantics by which that continuation is derived. The execution framework performs the applicable output processing and routing using those semantics.
Conceptually:
```text Pragma X | v Ergo A | v Pragma X.output | v Process Pragma Output | +----> Independent Pragma P1 ---> Mneme Pub/Sub / other governed use | +----> Independent Pragma P2 ---> another Praxis / other consumer | +----> Pathway-continuation Pragma X' | v Route | v Ergo B ```
This is a conceptual distinction, not a processing algorithm, identity rule, mandatory fan-out cardinality or physical pipeline. Other resulting Pragma are independently available governed artefacts: they may participate in Mneme Publish/Subscribe, another Praxis, other governed Harmonia processing, or no further processing. Availability does not imply publication, selection, handoff or execution, and does not bypass applicable governance.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md` — ## 4. Continuation is a role; representation is deferred. Standing: Architecturally adjudicated U18; candidate scope and representation deferrals retained.
**Pathway-continuation is a role played by a Pragma.** This adjudication creates no Pragma subtype or physical representation. In particular, `X'` in the diagram denotes derived continuation information, not a mandated new object identity.
Future detailed modelling must determine whether:
1. a new Pragma is always constructed for continuation; 2. one of the resulting output Pragma may be designated as the continuation Pragma; or 3. another governed representation is appropriate.
That decision is explicitly deferred. No schema, designation mechanism, factory extension, copy/version rule or persistence mechanism follows from this note.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/design-notes/DesignNote-Pragma-Outputs-and-Pathway-Continuation.md` — ## 6. Responsibility boundaries. Standing: Architecturally adjudicated U18; candidate scope and representation deferrals retained.
| Responsibility | Established allocation | | :--- | :--- | | Praxis, Pathway and Journey management | Energeia retains established management responsibilities; Praxis defines fulfilment, applicable Context and continuation semantics. | | Governed execution, output processing and routing | Ponos/Ergo execution framework applies those semantics; Ergon supplies bounded behaviour within the existing contract. Praxis does not orchestrate or choreograph execution. | | Context and Pragma management; semantic Publish/Subscribe | Mneme retains governed information management, creation/initialisation through established PragmaFactory responsibility, selection and availability. | | Durable physical handoff, where applicable | Petasos retains concrete persistent handoff obligations, queue operations and recovery; semantic selection remains Mneme's. | | Authoritative durable information and audit | Mnemosyne establishes durable state; Kleio retains authoritative audit capture. Harmonia SHALL ensure that the applicable Themis Passport is available across internal component and subsystem interactions, preserving the authorisation capability and its governing context. The Passport is a preconstructed Themis snapshot of effective authorisation capability, not identity credentials; availability may be by governed reference.
The Solution Architect's complete Subject/Views Task explicitly approves this native Principle / ArchitecturalAxiom for the governed Continuum. The incoming candidate/pending-ADD caption records its earlier source standing; it does not override this subsequent inclusion approval. Original source wording, native type, specialisation and Exchange identity evidence remain recoverable in the retained immutable 004 export. This incorporation supplies neither HCRL closure nor actual Archi visual acceptance.
This element retains its own bounded meaning. Broader existing security, authorisation, messaging or stakeholder concerns do not establish identity equivalence. No unrelated incoming properties, relationships, classifications, Capability allocations or OpenSpec candidates are incorporated.

element.name: [CT2] Clinical Safety Management
element.documentation:
Manage the clinical-risk distinctions materially required for R1/R2.
Clinical Safety Management distinguishes recognising a safety risk from reducing future exposure and actively dealing with a developing or materialised concern. These responsibilities may use overlapping evidence, but their purposes differ: characterisation makes the risk intelligible, mitigation changes prospective risk, and response addresses the situation requiring action.
**Intent**
Support proportionate safety action grounded in the nature of the identified clinical risk.
**Boundary**
Monitoring evidence is not automatically risk identification. Other capabilities can perform required actions without transferring their responsibilities; the three children are not a mandatory sequence or exhaustive safety taxonomy.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [650ccec030fa46cc8c9d6b508a841778](650ccec030fa46cc8c9d6b508a841778.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.

element.name: [CT2] Financial & Commercial Services
element.documentation:
Provide the financial/commercial business context materially required for R1/R2.
Financial & Commercial Services provides the financial business frame needed for the bounded R1/R2 responsibility. Its established child identifies and supplies information about chargeable or cost-relevant clinical activity. The purpose is to make applicable activity evidence available to the responsible financial context without expanding the model into pricing, claims or revenue management.
**Intent**
Support legitimate funding, financial and charging purposes with relevant clinical-activity information.
**Boundary**
Not every exchanged request or activity is chargeable. Provision of evidence does not establish a charging decision or an enterprise financial system.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: GovernedSummaryReader
element.documentation:
Authoritatively acquire the IU Summary without dereferencing, inspecting or transferring actual Content. This is an authoritative Mnemosyne read, not a cache peek; Mneme may subsequently populate/refresh its Standard Cache.
The IU Summary is the projection of the same accepted InformationUnit excluding **exactly InformationRepresentation.Content**. It retains Identity, applicable Metadata (ManagementContext, InformationCoordinates, SecurityContext, LifecycleContext and optional Relationships), ContainerMetadata and ContentMetadata. A Content reference belongs in ContentMetadata and is opaque to Mneme; Mnemosyne/PersistenceService resolve it with InformationCoordinates. ContentReference is illustrative vocabulary, not a prescribed field encoding. Summary projection does not promote transient ManagementContext data to mandatory durable metadata, create a second IU/InformationRepresentation, independent metadata authority or Summary version lineage. Logical separate Content addressability does not require separate physical databases or a particular native transaction.
An explicit IU identity/version read returns that exact version or its factual absence/denial/failure/uncertainty; it never silently substitutes an older/newer version. version=* expresses version selection and is different from an exact-version request (AV-01).
All five contracts are synchronous governed request/response, with Calliope-owned factual Outcome (closed Success / Failure / Indeterminate and governed closed Reason vocabulary/extensions). Exact Reason members and stage codes remain deferred. Mnemosyne reports facts; Mneme determines consumer disposition without rewriting them. Transport/session timeout is not a factual operation Failure. Receipt, work acceptance, authoritative effect and end-to-end completion remain distinct.
Authentication and Themis policy apply: Readers require ACCESS + READ, SummarySearch invocation ACCESS + SEARCH and disclosed candidates ACCESS + READ, Writers CHANGE with the requested information operation. Protect identity, metadata, counts, pagination and other existence disclosures as well as Content. RequiredIU/SupportedIU capability matching grants no permission. Preserve source-near audit/provenance, Kleio mandatory capture authority/fail-closed obligations and Dokimasia/Provenance allocations; no blanket candidate event catalogue is promoted. Native database/query/provider values stay below the seam.
Every authoritative full or Summary mutation Success requires the applicable multi-site durable authoritative operation and actual resulting IU version, never cache success, local commit, replication queued or transport ACK. Immutable historical versions are preserved. Mneme retains individual-IU concurrency; eligible Mnemosyne instances must expose one coherent authoritative logical history or factual uncertainty. No extra seam transaction identifier or second version axis is introduced.
### Incorporation standing
Accepted complete Final.001 DRP semantics; authorised 1.1.24 ADD; actual incorporated candidate awaiting Solution Architect confirmation. Authority: operative Solution Architect Task and HCRL 1.1.24/001; input approval is distinct from result acceptance.
