element.name: Mnemosyne
element.documentation:
### Approved 1.1.24 incorporation — resulting candidate pending
The upper Mneme interaction now exposes exactly GovernedSummaryReader, GovernedSummaryWriter(CREATE, RETIRE), GovernedSummarySearch, GovernedReader and GovernedWriter. Historical GovernedSearch references below denote the same search identity now refined as sole SummarySearch; PersistenceService remains the separate lower contract, not a sixth upper method. Existing five-tier responsibilities and 1.1.23 authoritative-engine architecture remain unchanged.
Summary is the same IU projected without Content; its ContentMetadata reference is opaque to Mneme. Full write establishes coherent authoritative Content, reference and Summary; full read attempts Content materialisation. External Summary CREATE performs no external fetch/validation and no custody transfer. All authoritative mutations preserve multi-site durable Success, actual resulting version, immutable history, Themis and factual Indeterminate. Mnemosyne manages neither cache. Detailed lower-boundary/native mechanisms remain in their owning contracts.
### Accepted Mnemosyne authoritative persistence architecture — 1.1.23/001
This accepted Final.001 contribution refines the existing Mnemosyne identity; original contributions and their independent standing are preserved below. The exact resulting incorporation candidate awaits Solution Architect confirmation. Five logical responsibility tiers are represented by the linked ApplicationFunctions, assigned to Mnemosyne; they are not mandated Classes, modules, runtime processes, protocol boundaries or deployments.
| Tier | Responsibility | | --- | --- | | Mneme Adapter / Façade | GovernedReader/Writer/Search boundary; each instance registers supported IU types using Topics. | | InformationUnit Controller | Persistence-context governance; local execution of Themis-provided PDP/PEP, without independent policy authority or central PDP dependency. | | InformationUnit Constructor / Disassembler | Preserve/reconstruct atomic IU and exactly one governed InformationRepresentation, without semantic Content conversion. | | GovernedPersistenceFramework | PersistenceService state/workflow control, delegation, supervision, applicable watchdogs/timeouts and higher-level failure processing. | | Persistence Adapter | Provider-native execution, ACK, supplementary verification and native correlation establishing the delegated operation’s known result. |
PersistenceService is jointly realised by GPF control and adapter execution, not a sixth tier. The shared Calliope Outcome reports operation/stage knowledge; Mneme’s consumer disposition is a separate fact. A native ACK or active-cache success cannot substitute for governed authoritative durable acceptance.
| MP-02 responsibility | Allocation | | --- | --- | | Authoritative Persistence | Responsible. | | Authoritative Acquisition | Responsible. | | Governed Identity Preservation | Responsible. | | Authoritative Version / State Management | Partially Responsible across all information semantics; AX-05 durable authoritative state/version establishment remains Mnemosyne’s exclusive responsibility. | | Persistence Coordination | Responsible. | | InformationCoordinates Resolution | Partially Responsible for persistence/acquisition use. | | Governance Enforcement | Responsible within persistence context; other governing owners unchanged. | | Outcome Determination | Responsible within persistence context, not Mneme’s consumer disposition. | | Persistence Recoverability | Partially Responsible for ordinary persistence recovery; catastrophic-failure recovery orchestration excluded. |
Authoritative search executes/co-ordinates where the selected service capabilities support it. Mneme retains search intention, disclosure and governed Search Result Sets. Providers may have different additive capabilities, associated only with the actual supporting PersistenceService, without universal parity or fabricated support.
Multiple simultaneous Mnemosyne instances support identical, overlapping or disjoint IU-type subsets. Each Façade registers its capabilities; Mneme’s Mnemosyne Adapter (Store) discovers via existing TopicMasks and selects eligible instances for high availability/changeover and load balancing. Distinct IUs of the same registered type can execute concurrently. Mneme owns concurrency for an individual IU; all selected instances reach the same logical authoritative engine for that IU. Capability matching grants no authorisation, current-availability proof or authoritative IU ownership. Availability detection, balancing, routing and changeover mechanisms remain solution design.
The 1.1.22 IU UUID/Topic, Metadata contexts/four coordinate references, one InformationRepresentation, native Content, operational Version/Active Generation and distinct authoritative durable version remain intact. Durable reconstruction need not persist every transient ManagementContext field. Information authority, clinical/business meaning and transformation remain with their existing owners. Calliope owns shared/domain models, Themis policy/enforcement provision, Kleio AuditEvent management and Dokimasia existing Assurance/Provenance allocations. Retention/holds, ordinary recovery, catastrophe orchestration, diagnostics, audit and provenance retain their distinctions. Historical research/search/domain/shard contributions below are neither expanded nor retired by this task.
### Accepted Information Unit Framework incorporation — 1.1.22
Mnemosyne interprets an [IU](../data-object/class/74ec609de1ae498fbf9d13e4ef8c6cbe.md)'s four InformationCoordinates Topic references (PersistenceGateway, GatewayEndpoint, InformationLocation, InformationOwner) to resolve provider/service and access context. They are logical names, independent of security and embedded network configuration. Coordinate presence/population follows the governing contract. Providers may use native physical storage/decomposition; Mnemosyne must reconstruct/deliver the IU's single governed representation and required identity/Metadata/Content consistency. Physical storage forms are not alternate IU representations. Authoritative durable state/version, meaningful outcomes and preservation remain Mnemosyne responsibilities. LifecycleContext supports Mneme–Mnemosyne handshaking; acceptance of work is not necessarily authoritative remote completion. GovernedPersistenceFramework/PersistenceService describe the accepted boundary roles without creating interfaces, deployments, universal state vocabulary, transaction machinery or transformation services. Detailed provider asymmetry, acknowledgement and recovery remain with their governing designs.
- **Role/responsibility:** **Harmonia's Persistence Manager** under [U11](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/sources.md#u11), establishing authoritative durable state/version and the information/metadata required to sustain activity Context. Persistence conveys no originating information/application ownership. - **First-class responsibilities:** transaction oversight; persistent-service oversight/reporting; shard management; authoritative persistence reporting; persistence logging; compartment validation/reapplication; hosting Themis-owned PEP enforcement; **Search Management**; **Research Metadata Management**. [The management view](7985e647bf9e4ca3ba70faf9e3e4ae02.md) establishes each boundary. Underlying services may retain their own transactions; Mnemosyne does not become infrastructure management. - **Information/outcomes:** durable representations/version/metadata, persistence observations and outcomes, search capability metadata and distinct Research Metadata. API/engine success is not automatically the authoritative Harmonia outcome; uncertain effects remain explicit. Persistence logging is distinct from Kleio audit. - **Search:** Mneme exposes Adhoc Search; Mnemosyne performs underlying authoritative managed-persistence search, without treating a transient cache as complete. Persistence-domain/shard/service/search-index capability metadata may be managed. - **Research Metadata:** manages capture, persistence, management and search utilisation of AI-derived meaning/relationships across content sets based on proximity. Source Content remains unchanged and derived metadata distinguishable. Deriving AI processing executes **outside Mnemosyne** through appropriate Harmonia behaviour/ execution. Detailed provenance/confidence/schema remain unresolved. - **Persistence domains:** Clinical Information, C&G and O&A retain U06 guardrails: coherent C&G authority; O&A horizontal partitionability preserving identity, provenance, relationships and meaning. Domains select no database/service topology or shard key. Mnemosyne manages shards within semantic constraints, without independently deciding sharding safety. - **Governance:** compartments are validated/reapplied without loss or weakening; semantic applicability is not independently determined here. Themis owns PEP semantics and Criteria; Mnemosyne controls/prevents the persistence operation. Kleio mandatory AuditEvent persistence uses its [governed intrinsic platform authority](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/component-register.md#kleio-capture-authority), distinct from the audited Identity; Mnemosyne gains no equivalent intrinsic authority. - **Existing registry support:** server-side Provider Registry durable integrity, preservation/history and recovery responsibilities remain as described in C13 and the data view; this correction does not redesign their semantic validation. - **Collaboration/exclusions:** Mneme manages Context/Pragma information consequences; Mnemosyne establishes/reports persistence. Energeia observes/reports persistence operational state, without acquiring management. No application-facing raw storage, AI derivation inside Mnemosyne, technology selection or workflow engine is established. - **Standing:** U11 and explicit task decisions settle responsibilities; detailed oversight/transaction/compartment/outcome/search/Research Metadata contracts remain CDG-47/48, alongside historical structures CDG-12/13/40.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/context-and-persistence-management.md` — ## Mnemosyne — Persistence Manager. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
> **Mneme manages the information context of Harmonia activity; Mnemosyne manages > the authoritative persistence of the information/metadata required to sustain > that Context and reports authoritative persistence outcomes.**
Mnemosyne is Harmonia's **Persistence Manager**, with first-class responsibilities:
| Responsibility | Meaning and boundary | | :--- | :--- | | **Transaction oversight** | Harmonia-level oversight of persistence activity and outcome; heterogeneous services may retain their own transaction mechanics. No single physical or distributed transaction mechanism is prescribed. | | **Persistent-service oversight and reporting** | Determine whether persistent services can fulfil Harmonia persistence responsibilities and report outcomes; this is distinct from IT/Ops infrastructure management. | | **Shard management** | Manage shards within established semantic constraints; Mnemosyne does not independently decide a domain is semantically safe to shard. | | **Authoritative persistence reporting** | Establish and report Harmonia's authoritative persistence outcome, preserving confirmed, degraded and indeterminate distinctions. | | **Persistence logging** | Provide persistence-management operational logging; this does not replace Kleio Audit Capture or automatically become AuditEvent. Zero-PHI diagnostic controls apply. | | **Compartment validation/reapplication** | Validate and reapply applicable compartments at the persistence boundary; persistence SHALL NOT strip, weaken or lose classification. Mnemosyne does not independently determine semantic applicability. | | **Themis-owned PEP hosting** | Prevent governed persistence operations through Themis-owned enforcement; Identity-derived operations use applicable PEP-Criteria through PEP-Context. Mandatory Kleio capture uses its specifically adjudicated governed platform authority. Themis retains policy/enforcement semantics; capture-authority representation/mechanisms remain deferred. | | **Search Management** | Perform underlying authoritative managed-persistence search and manage supporting Harmonia-level persistence search metadata. | | **Research Metadata Management** | Manage capture, persistence, management and search utilisation of distinct AI-derived Research Metadata; derivation executes outside Mnemosyne. |
Mnemosyne atomically establishes authoritative durable state/version progression and required durable management metadata under AX-05. **Persistence API/engine success is not automatically an authoritative Harmonia persistence outcome.** Service responses require the governing persistence contract and outcome oversight; uncertainty SHALL remain explicit under AX-15. Cache state or successful Ergon execution cannot substitute for authoritative persistence.
Persistence responsibility confers no originating clinical, information or application ownership. The established [Clinical/C&G/O&A semantic domains](../../../../docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/data-and-persistence.md#persistence-responsibility-domains) remain: coherent C&G governance authority, O&A partitionability preserving meaning, and no prescribed database/service topology. Energeia may observe/report Mnemosyne operational state under **R1.x/R2.x Observe → Report**, without acquiring persistence management or infrastructure authority.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/context-and-persistence-management.md` — ## Mnemosyne Search Management. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
**Search Management is a first-class Mnemosyne responsibility.** Mneme exposes **Adhoc Search** at the activity/context-facing layer; Mnemosyne performs the underlying authoritative persistence search. This does not expose its storage implementation as an application-access path.
Search SHALL operate against **authoritative managed persistence**, without assuming a transient cache is the complete searchable information space. Mnemosyne MAY manage Harmonia-level search metadata for persistence-domain, shard, persistent-service and search/index capabilities. Research Metadata is distinct from, but usable by, Search Management. Query/result contracts, completeness/consistency detail and physical search/index technology remain unresolved; no distributed search algorithm is prescribed.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/05-information-systems-architecture/context-and-persistence-management.md` — ## Mnemosyne Research Metadata Management. Standing: Candidate — adjudicated Domain05 Step-B baseline; final Solution Architecture unapproved.
**Research Metadata Management is a first-class Mnemosyne responsibility, distinct from Search Management.** Research Metadata supports AI-derived capture of **"meaning" or relationships across content sets based on proximity**.
Authoritative source Content SHALL remain unchanged. AI-derived Research Metadata SHALL remain distinguishable from authoritative source Content and metadata; durable capture of a derived assertion does not confer source-content authority or turn inference into observed fact.
```text Authoritative source Content → appropriate governed Harmonia behavioural/execution construct → AI derivation outside Mnemosyne → distinct Research Metadata → Mnemosyne capture / persistence / management → utilisation by Search Management ```
Mnemosyne manages the metadata and its search utilisation; the deriving AI processing SHALL NOT execute within Mnemosyne. No specific Ergon class, Dokimasia allocation or new execution framework is inferred. The appropriate Harmonia construct retains governed execution/security and originating authority boundaries. No AI framework, model/provider, vector technology, embedding mechanism, proximity algorithm or physical index is selected. Detailed **provenance, confidence and Research Metadata schema remain unresolved**.

## Candidate ADD — Provenance Management and Assurance
Governed Provenance information managed through Mneme is durably persisted through Mnemosyne using the existing governed persistence mechanisms. Dokimasia's Provenance Management ownership is distinct from physical persistence and does not create an independent persistence subsystem. Existing authoritative-state/version/outcome, information-authority, security and governance semantics remain intact. Reliable, durable and timely information management remains subject to existing requirements, including AX-05/10/11; no new SLA, storage technology, domain/shard allocation, API, publication timing, acknowledgement or recovery mechanism is determined.
Agreed intent is recorded in the operative ADD Task; this contribution awaits explicit Solution Architect candidate acceptance under HCRL 1.1.19-001 DR-18/DR-19. Prior definitions, assertion standing and unresolved detailed-design matters are preserved.

element.documentation:
Coordinate outpatient arrival, clinic flow, follow-up requirements and context-specific outpatient capacity information.
**Overview**
Coordinate outpatient arrival, clinic flow, follow-up requirements and context-specific outpatient capacity information. The reviewed hierarchy assigns this enduring ability to its stated business-enabling context.
**Intent**
Coordinate outpatient arrival, clinic flow, follow-up requirements and context-specific outpatient capacity information.

element.name: [CT2] Mobile Staff Management
element.documentation:
Mobile Staff Management integrates with external business mobile-work mechanisms and receives visit progression and safety milestones. Its established dispatch Feature exchanges assignment, dispatch and status information with the relevant worker context. This is an information integration boundary around mobile activity, rather than a platform claim to decide the clinician's work.
**Overview**
Mobile Staff Management integrates with external business mobile-work mechanisms and receives visit progression and safety milestones. Its established dispatch Feature exchanges assignment, dispatch and status information with the relevant worker context. This is an information integration boundary around mobile activity, rather than a platform claim to decide the clinician's work.
**Intent**
Mobile Staff Management integrates with external business mobile-work mechanisms and receives visit progression and safety milestones. Its established dispatch Feature exchanges assignment, dispatch and status information with the relevant worker context. This is an information integration boundary around mobile activity, rather than a platform claim to decide the clinician's work.
**Boundary**

---
## History
### Boundary — predecessor explanation
Harmonia does not determine clinical allocation, handover or EMR worklists. External work/task language does not redefine the internal Synthetic Task.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Mobile assignment and progression exchanges materially connect roving activity to the wider care environment within that bounded integration role.

element.name: [CT3] Care Effectiveness Review
element.documentation:
Evaluate whether delivered care is achieving or has achieved its intended goals and outcomes.
Care Effectiveness Review evaluates delivered care against its intended goals and outcomes. It connects observed response to the reason the care was undertaken, making a judgement that monitoring alone does not supply. An effectiveness finding can inform review of appropriateness while preserving the possibility that a reasonable care choice has not achieved its objective.
**Boundary**
Observed improvement is not automatically proof that the intended objectives have been achieved or that continuing care is appropriate.

element.name: [CT3] Diagnostic Service Delivery
element.documentation:
Perform the diagnostic activity that obtains or produces diagnostic evidence.
Diagnostic Service Delivery performs the activity that obtains or produces diagnostic evidence. Within Diagnostic Support Provision it is the point at which the diagnostic procedure actually occurs, rather than being scheduled or requested. The evidence obtained can then be managed and interpreted under the distinct responsibilities that give it professional meaning.
**Boundary**
Performance does not itself establish interpretation, report authorisation or report delivery.

element.name: [CT1] Health Rights, Advocacy & Participation
element.documentation:
Protecting patient rights, facilitating informed consent, managing advance care directives, supporting patient advocacy, and enabling consumer participation in health decisions.
This capability represents the organisation's responsibility to protect patients' rights and enable their voice in health decisions. Consent, advance care directives, advocacy and consumer participation concern the legitimacy and personal consequences of care, rather than merely the availability of clinical information. The governed model retains this broad enterprise responsibility without an established subordinate capability set.
**Intent**
Support informed participation and respect for the individual's rights in decisions affecting their health.
**Boundary**
Recording a directive or restricting access can support rights without performing advocacy or managing consumer participation.
**Harmonia Architectural Relevance**
The established Adjacent classification reflects the use and supply of consent and record-access evidence. It does not assign the underlying rights, advocacy or participation activity to Harmonia.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [58376e5c53bf4af0a54f99f21ac52666](58376e5c53bf4af0a54f99f21ac52666.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Device Integration Provision
element.documentation:
Establish and maintain the device’s capability and configuration to participate in applicable information exchanges.
Clinical Device Integration Provision establishes the device capability and configuration required to participate in applicable information exchanges. Its outcome is an integration-ready arrangement, which must remain distinguishable from data actually acquired or exchanged. This allows an architect to discuss whether connectivity has been enabled without assuming that a particular clinical feed has operated successfully.
**Boundary**
Provisioning does not demonstrate data integration, clinical interpretation or downstream authority for the data.

element.name: [CT3] Non-Prescription Medication Provision
element.documentation:
Provide medication not requiring an applicable prescription, subject to professional, regulatory and safety controls.
Non-Prescription Medication Provision makes medication available where the applicable conditions do not require a prescription. It remains a professional, regulated and safety-constrained responsibility rather than an unrestricted supply transaction. Its distinction from prescription dispensing preserves the different authority basis under which provision occurs.
**Boundary**
Provision neither establishes diagnosis nor proves use or administration of the medication.
## Capability model replacement history

element.documentation:
Track occupancy and status of emergency cubicles, resuscitation bays, and short-stay beds.
Emergency-place tracking distinguishes occupancy and status across cubicles, resuscitation bays and short-stay beds. It provides place context for departmental operations while leaving the service's usable capacity and clinical triage decisions separate from an inventory of spaces.

element.name: [Feature] Bed Availability Tracking
element.documentation:
Maintain operational status of all registered beds and care-places (VACANT, OCCUPIED, BLOCKED, RESERVED, DIRTY, CLEANING, CLEAN).
Availability tracking preserves the operational distinctions among vacancy, occupancy, reservation, blockage and cleaning conditions. These states support meaningful care-place coordination without equating an unoccupied bed with a ready place or usable service capacity.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). Primary replacement catalogue identity `B09.01.01.F04`; additional scope correspondences: . Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [CT3] Health Service Resource Identification
element.documentation:
Identify required workforce, facilities, equipment, clinical technology, ICT, administration and support resources without owning them.
This capability establishes the resources a service requires across workforce, facilities, equipment, clinical technology, ICT and support. It makes resource needs visible in the service's alignment context without treating identification as procurement, ownership or allocation. Required resources can therefore be discussed distinctly from resources presently available or deployed.
**Boundary**
Identifying resources does not operate them, assign them to care or establish collective service readiness.
## Capability model replacement history

element.name: Adjudicate Assurance Assessment
element.documentation:
• Canonical Name: Adjudicate Assurance Assessment.
• Definition: Determines the assurance finding or conclusion that follows from the assessed evidence and applicable assurance criteria.
• Boundary: Establishment of the finding/conclusion is part of adjudication. It remains distinct from evidence assessment, operational response, remediation, escalation, workflow progression and clinical judgement. No separate conclusion-establishment or reporting Function is introduced merely because a conclusion is established or may be communicated.
---
## History
### Function Overview — predecessor explanation
Adjudication establishes the supported finding or conclusion from assessed detail. It is distinct from gathering evidence and from reporting an outcome already reached. Insufficiency must remain explicit rather than be forced into satisfaction or non-satisfaction, and the resulting finding does not acquire authority to remediate the subject.

element.name: [Feature] Referral Destination Coordination
element.documentation:
Coordinate qualified referral destination resolution and convey the request under its applicable disposition contract.
**Overview**
Referral intake and status capture leave a distinct routing responsibility: finding the intended service and preserving redirection without turning technical delivery into assumed care responsibility.
**Boundary**
Does not make clinical triage decisions or infer Transfer of Care from acceptance.

element.name: [CT3] Information Model Education
element.documentation:
Support organisational understanding and appropriate use of adopted information models.
Information Model Education supports understanding and appropriate use of adopted models. It addresses the people and practice dimension of semantic consistency: a published model is not necessarily a model understood in the contexts where it is applied. Its responsibility therefore complements adoption and compliance without becoming either.
**Boundary**
Educational support neither changes the authoritative model nor establishes that actual use complies with it.

element.name: [Feature] Hierarchical Structure Navigation
element.documentation:
Model, traverse, and resolve nested departmental, divisional, and regional healthcare networks.
Hierarchy navigation makes departmental, divisional and network relationships usable without flattening them into unrelated organisations. Traversal reflects established structure; it does not create corporate authority or infer responsibility from the way a directory happens to display a tree.

element.name: PEP-Criteria
element.documentation:
**PEP-Criteria is a precomputed, Identity-specific set of permitted combinations**, not a general-purpose executable policy language distributed to PEPs. Themis resolves direct Criteria, AuthorisationRole-derived Criteria, nested collections, applicable temporal constraints, PractitionerCapacity context where applicable and authoritative policy state. PEPs SHALL NOT receive the complete model merely because they need enforcement information.
Themis derives this information; PEP-Context supplies it to constrained local enforcement. It is not a general-purpose policy language or a persisted resource by default.

element.name: [CT3] Governance Requirement Publication Support
element.documentation:
Represent and publish versioned governing requirements for use by authorised operational and assurance consumers.
**Overview**
Consumers need an identifiable statement of which rule applies and who established it. This proposal fills BC-17 information support without giving the platform authority to make legislation, approve governance requirements or reinterpret their force.
**Intent**
Let operational and assurance consumers identify the governing statement and applicability basis they actually used.
**Boundary**
Governance approval remains externally mandated; operational policy, assurance criteria and requirement authority are not interchangeable.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). Primary replacement catalogue identity `B11.05.01`; additional scope correspondences: `E04.05.01`. Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [CT3] Health History Assessment
element.documentation:
Establish relevant health knowledge from the individual’s history and applicable historical/contextual information.
Health History Assessment establishes clinically relevant understanding from a person's history and its surrounding context. Within assessment it contributes knowledge that a current examination or measurement alone may not reveal, while requiring consideration of the relevance of historical information to the present situation. Access to previous records can assist, but the responsibility is the assessment of history rather than retrieval itself.
**Boundary**
Historical information does not become a current clinical conclusion merely because it is available; interpretation of the assessed findings remains Clinical Determination.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [bcaacf446f45443eafd8e21a1fd74ee1](bcaacf446f45443eafd8e21a1fd74ee1.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.

element.name: [CT2] Health Workforce Management
element.documentation:
Govern practitioners’ professional standing, engagement/privilege and whole-enterprise service coverage.
Health Workforce Management governs practitioners' professional standing, authorised participation and the ability to cover required enterprise work. Its three children separate qualification from engagement and privilege, and both from whole-enterprise coverage. This prevents an available or rostered person from being treated as automatically qualified and privileged for a particular activity.
**Intent**
Support legitimate practitioner participation and an informed understanding of service-coverage gaps and risks.
**Boundary**
Coverage is broader than rostering. Applying an available resource to a care requirement and progressing a particular support work item remain separate operational responsibilities.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: [CT3] Patient Health Information Disclosure Management
element.documentation:
Manage permitted patient health-information disclosure and its applicable recipient, purpose and restriction conditions.
**Overview**
Manage permitted patient health-information disclosure and its applicable recipient, purpose and restriction conditions. The reviewed hierarchy assigns this enduring ability to its stated business-enabling context.
**Intent**
Manage permitted patient health-information disclosure and its applicable recipient, purpose and restriction conditions.
**Boundary**
Information administration and coordination preserve the authority of the responsible source, clinical actor and governed domain; they confer no additional real-world management authority. Client consent directives remain owned by Client Privacy Guardrail Management (FEAT-EM-09); this capability references and respects those determinations without defining a second consent owner.

element.name: Continuous Clinical Service Availability
element.documentation:
### Context & Pressure Healthcare delivery is continuous, mission-critical, and time-sensitive (24/7/365). In emergency departments, intensive care units, and operating theaters, clinical decisions cannot be paused for integration system downtime, database maintenance, or middleware restarts.
A failure in the integration environment directly impacts patient care: an emergency physician cannot view critical drug allergy records; a surgeon cannot inspect pre-operative pathology results; an inpatient unit cannot receive bed transfer notifications.
### Architectural Imperative Harmonia must provide continuous clinical service availability. The platform must withstand hardware failures, network partitions, and downstream destination outages without dropping incoming clinical events or blocking point-of-care clinical queries.
- **Primary Stakeholders**: [Clinicians & Care Teams](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/stakeholders/enterprise-stakeholders.md), [Platform Operations & Integration Engineers](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/stakeholders/enterprise-stakeholders.md), [Healthcare Delivery Organizations](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/stakeholders/enterprise-stakeholders.md) - **Key Assessments**: [Silent Data Loss via False Acceptance](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/drivers-assessments/assessments.md), [Centralised Synchronous Persistence Can Constrain Concurrency](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/drivers-assessments/assessments.md) - **Associated Goals**: [Durable Acceptance & Preservation of Clinical Events](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/goals-outcomes/strategic-goals.md), [Responsive Access to Managed Information](../../../../docs/markdown/01-motivation/goals-outcomes/strategic-goals.md) - **Governing Axioms**: [AX-10 (Failure as Normal Condition)](../principle/0d9673833eb840eab03804aa076c1b0c.md), [AX-11 (Responsive & Resilient Access)](../principle/8a1e995f16954484a78ae1c5c114d546.md), [AX-05 (State Separation)](../principle/0412a2084f0145babc4f022c71fea65f.md)

element.name: GovernedPersistenceFramework
element.documentation:
GovernedPersistenceFramework (GPF) is Mnemosyne's accepted fourth responsibility tier. It controls PersistenceService state and workflow, delegates and correlates operations, and may provide supervision, watchdogs, timeout handling and higher-level failure processing.
GPF and Persistence Adapter jointly realise PersistenceService: GPF supplies state/workflow control and the adapter supplies technology-specific execution and verification. Each Realization relationship records a contribution to that joint capability, not independent fulfilment by either tier. PersistenceService is not a sixth tier, and GPF is not all Mnemosyne governance or a mandatory separately deployed code framework.
GPF correlates delegation with service/workflow state while the adapter correlates native operations and acknowledgements. A watchdog expiry may justify reporting Indeterminate at this point; it proves neither failure nor success of an in-flight write. GPF must not reinterpret a factual adapter result or perform technology-specific verification on its behalf. Safe reconciliation/retry follows the governing operation contract; no universal state machine, timeout, retry algorithm or guaranteed eventual resolution is prescribed.
### Incorporation standing
Accepted parent DRP semantics, incorporated under the operative Task for 1.1.23/001. Actual resulting candidate confirmation remains pending. Earlier component/source qualifications remain independently in force.

element.name: [Feature] Encounter Context Creation
element.documentation:
Create and maintain authoritative encounter tracking contexts for hospital admissions, outpatient visits, and community contacts.
Encounter context creation supplies an identifiable frame for information concerning a particular admission, visit or contact. Its governed tracking authority concerns the encounter representation within Harmonia; it does not make Harmonia the originator of every clinical fact associated with that encounter.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). Primary replacement catalogue identity `E07.03.06`; additional scope correspondences: . Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [CT2] Preventative Health
element.documentation:
Address preventative-health needs through organised activity with sufficient R1/R2 distinctions.
Preventative Health organises a response to a health problem before adverse outcomes arise or worsen. The established children distinguish why attention is warranted, how an organised programme is managed, who it targets, the education provided, what programme operation shows and what is reported. This allows a screening or immunisation programme to be explained without creating a new capability for every programme type.
**Intent**
Connect a preventative purpose with an identifiable target population and observable organised activity.
**Boundary**
Programme performance differs from population-health assessment and individual clinical monitoring. Unmodelled specialist responsibilities are not silently assigned to the existing children.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [80affa7bcd284ecbbcbc5092f8497ddf](80affa7bcd284ecbbcbc5092f8497ddf.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.
## Capability model replacement history

Primary replacement catalogue identity `B13.02`; additional scope correspondences: . Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: Integrate Mobile Work Management
element.documentation:
Exchanges externally established work/assignment, dispatch and operational progression/status information, with applicable worker/context information, between mobile work-management mechanisms and Harmonia operational coordination.
Derivation and boundary: The human adjudication of FEAT-HSO-16 establishes integration with mobile work/task management. This responsibility is absent from presence observation and visit-specific milestone ingestion. It does not determine, allocate or manage the underlying clinical work, clinical handover or EMR worklists. Work Allocation & Dispatch retains non-clinical operational Work Order responsibility.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/03-business-architecture/behaviours/04-health-service-operations.md` — entry lines 203-203. Standing: exact originating assertion; current resource standing unchanged.

This responsibility is absent from presence observation and visit-specific milestone ingestion. It does not determine, allocate or manage the underlying clinical work, clinical handover or EMR worklists. Work Allocation & Dispatch retains non-clinical operational Work Order responsibility.
## Source-qualified contribution

- *Terminology*: External “work/task” vocabulary does not make human work a Harmonia Task. Work Order means human doing; To Do means human review/update/approval; Task means synthetic task. The preferred Strategy name `Mobile Work Task Management Integration` remains a proposed naming correction pending human confirmation, not a new Feature or alias.

element.name: [CT2] Diagnostic Support Provision
element.documentation:
Provide diagnostic services and manage their evidence, interpretation and governed reporting.
Diagnostic Support Provision covers the distinct responsibilities through which a diagnostic service obtains evidence and makes its findings available. Diagnostic scheduling, service performance, specimen stewardship, data management, interpretation, report governance and report distribution each establish a different outcome. Their separation allows preliminary, amended or final information to retain its professional and evidentiary standing without treating delivery as authorisation.
**Intent**
Make diagnostic evidence and professionally governed findings usable by the appropriate care participants.
**Boundary**
Diagnostic interpretation is limited to the service's professional scope; patient-level Clinical Determination considers the wider clinical context. The children do not prescribe a universal diagnostic workflow or establish a Diagnostic Order Management capability.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: [CT3] Diagnostic Interpretation
element.documentation:
Establish what diagnostic evidence demonstrates within the diagnostic service’s professional scope.
Diagnostic Interpretation establishes what diagnostic evidence demonstrates within the service's professional scope. It turns evidence into diagnostic findings without claiming the wider patient-level judgement that considers all clinical circumstances. Separating interpretation from acquisition and reporting makes the professional contribution clear even when one service performs all three.
**Boundary**
Patient-level Clinical Determination remains distinct, as do report authorisation and distribution.

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Quality Review & Assessment Management
element.documentation:
Review evidence against applicable criteria and establish a clinical-quality assessment, finding or conclusion.
This capability evaluates quality evidence against applicable criteria and establishes a finding, assessment or conclusion. It is the judgement-bearing responsibility within Clinical Quality Management, distinct from maintaining the material and from communicating the result. Making that distinction supports scrutiny of the criterion and evidentiary basis for a quality assessment.
**Boundary**
An assessment is not a report of itself or the subsequent improvement action it may inform.

element.name: [CT2] Population Health Surveillance
element.documentation:
Understand population-health state and manage organised surveillance, significant events and applicable notification.
Population Health Surveillance establishes patterns and change across a defined population and manages the surveillance arrangements through which they are considered. Its children separate longitudinal assessment, surveillance management, event identification, formal notification and reporting. These distinctions matter because an observed pattern can be significant without being notifiable, and identifying a notifiable event does not demonstrate that the notification obligation has been discharged.
**Intent**
Make population-health concerns and applicable communication obligations visible in their population and temporal context.
**Boundary**
Notification management does not define the obligation or own the operational response. Surveillance evidence can inform other abilities without establishing their findings.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: [CT2] Longitudinal & Community Care Integration
element.documentation:
Support continuity, remote participation and preventive follow-up through appropriately assembled and exchanged care context.
**Overview**
Support continuity, remote participation and preventive follow-up through appropriately assembled and exchanged care context. Its constituent abilities distinguish Primary Care; Community Care; Outreach Care; Remote & Virtual Care; Preventive Care.
**Intent**
Support continuity when care information must follow the person across providers, visits and distance.
**Boundary**
Longitudinal purpose does not make these care contexts exclusive. Outreach location and remote mode remain distinct from source clinical responsibility.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). element.name: Establish, exercise and revise consent choices
element.documentation:
An evidenced need to establish, exercise and revise consent choices arises. Progresses towards: Applicable consent, refusal, restrictions and changes can inform permitted activities and remain explainable and attributable.
### Alternative outcomes and conditions
- The request may be declined, rejected or held for further evidence under the applicable source conditions. - An uncertain state or incomplete prerequisite does not establish success.
Progression may be conditional or long-running. A correction or review may revisit an earlier constituent. Independent work may progress concurrently only where its applicable prerequisites permit; this definition prescribes no scheduler or execution order.
This is a reusable Journey definition. Actual progress, decisions and outcomes belong to particular occurrences. It selects no workflow engine, orchestration, runtime state machine or execution owner.

element.name: [CT3] Outreach Care Continuity
element.documentation:
Definition unresolved in the baseline. No definition has been synthesised from the name.
---
## History
### Capability Overview — predecessor explanation
Outreach Care supplies portable clinical context and receives documentation from rural or remote outreach activity. It addresses continuity where the relevant care information may not be available through the usual on-site environment. The responsibility connects the prior record with the outcomes reported after the visit while keeping source and temporal context intelligible.
### Boundary — predecessor explanation
An offline-capable summary does not acquire clinical authority or guarantee that the remote copy represents current authoritative state.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Context provision and outcome ingestion materially connect outreach activity to the longitudinal record.
## Qualified relationship assertions
Original source predicates, evidence and qualifications remain in the metadata. The ARB has now adjudicated their native treatment; explicitly unestablished relationship existence remains excluded. Native representation does not promote source standing.

element.name: [Feature] Clinical Communication Distribution
element.documentation:
Distribute secure clinical communications between verified healthcare providers and designated care team endpoints.
Clinical communication distribution connects verified providers and designated team endpoints through governed addressed delivery. The responsibility concerns reaching the intended participant, rather than assuming that delivered information has been read, incorporated or acted upon clinically.

element.name: [CT3] Health Information Lifecycle Management
element.documentation:
Govern state, amendment, correction, supersession, currency, retention and disposition while preserving provenance and historical meaning.
Health Information Lifecycle Management governs how information's state and temporal standing change through amendment, correction, supersession, retention and disposition. It allows current knowledge to change without retrospectively rewriting what was previously received, known or managed. That distinction supports interpretation of both the present representation and its historical operational meaning.
**Boundary**
Current authoritative state differs from historical truth; preserving either does not confer originating authority for the represented facts.
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). Primary replacement catalogue identity `E01.04.04`; additional scope correspondences: `E01.02`. Original canonical/Exchange identities and source contributions remain reserved. Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [CT2] Client-Centred Administration
element.documentation:
Client-Centred Administration receives demographic and registration changes and makes verified updates available to participating clinical systems. It connects administrative events from external PAS environments with the client context used across care. The enabling responsibility concerns integration of changes, rather than independently deciding the authoritative demographic truth whenever a source sends an update.
**Overview**
Client-Centred Administration receives demographic and registration changes and makes verified updates available to participating clinical systems. It connects administrative events from external PAS environments with the client context used across care. The enabling responsibility concerns integration of changes, rather than independently deciding the authoritative demographic truth whenever a source sends an update.
**Intent**
Client-Centred Administration receives demographic and registration changes and makes verified updates available to participating clinical systems. It connects administrative events from external PAS environments with the client context used across care. The enabling responsibility concerns integration of changes, rather than independently deciding the authoritative demographic truth whenever a source sends an update.
**Boundary**
Information administration does not confer authority over the represented person, organisation, service, place, device or clinical activity.
---
## History
### Boundary — predecessor explanation
Ingestion and distribution do not establish master clinical identity reconciliation or authority over the originating registration process.
### Harmonia Architectural Relevance — predecessor explanation
Demographic changes materially affect downstream association and continuity, so their governed propagation is active enablement rather than passive directory context.
## Source-qualified contribution
Source: `docs/markdown/03-business-architecture/behaviours/02-service-administration.md` — entry lines 12-12. Standing: exact originating assertion; current resource standing unchanged.
- **Owning Capability**: `Client-Centred Administration`
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [232b3fb2ff204c9b9ff7a60ff6a7a32d](232b3fb2ff204c9b9ff7a60ff6a7a32d.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.
## ARB source correspondence
Scope/anti-responsibility and clinical/operational meaning establish the responsible Capability; descriptive ledger/registry/asset labels do not establish a separately bounded formal Information Concept. Preserve non-transfer and source authority.
Source: `docs/markdown/03-business-architecture/information-responsibility/information-responsibility.md` — information responsibility row 10. Standing: Established Business responsibility only; formal information identity/lifecycle not inferred.
```text | **Client-Centred Administration** | **Administrative Intake Ledger** | Departmental registration intake queues, administrative demographic modification batches, and demographic distribution subscriber lists. | Does not own authoritative person master identity. | ```
## Capability model replacement history
The original content above remains historical and unchanged. This resource is superseded under [the replacement task](../../../design/evidence/1.1.20/001/before/CapabilityReplacementTask.md). That earlier incoming record has no Documentation or authored Properties; no normative definition, native statement, classification of individual statements, or additional responsibility is invented to complete that absence.
The Task explicitly establishes parent-to-child Composition as containment and a separate directed child-to-parent Home Association as authoritative architectural location. These are distinct assertions. Neither diagram membership nor the Grouping's label alone establishes another Home or a statement allocation. No component ownership, implementation dependency, Capability decomposition, new Motivation statement or OpenSpec candidate incorporation is conferred.

element.name: [Feature] Zero-PHI Collaboration Metadata Governance
element.documentation:
Ensure collaboration channel titles, topics, and aliases use opaque identifiers free of patient names, MRNs, or sensitive details.
Metadata governance keeps patient names, identifiers and sensitive detail out of collaboration titles, topics and aliases. Opaque references preserve useful contextual association without placing PHI in broadly visible channel metadata or diagnostic surfaces.

Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.

element.name: [CT3] Clinical Examination
element.documentation:
Establish health findings through clinical examination.
Clinical Examination establishes findings through examination of the individual. It distinguishes directly acquired clinical knowledge from the historical account and the measurement-focused contribution of its assessment siblings. Its outcome is a set of examination findings that can inform clinical interpretation, irrespective of the setting or profession exercising the ability.
**Boundary**
An examination finding is not itself a diagnosis, care plan or performed treatment.

Historical identity [8bc15e2b8f114deebcbbe3f2013a8147](8bc15e2b8f114deebcbbe3f2013a8147.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.

element.name: [ArchitecturalAxiom] AX-17 Architectural Authority and Explicit Uncertainty
element.documentation:
#### Axiom
Documented architectural decisions, definitions, relationships, boundaries and constraints are authoritative and SHALL NOT be silently reinterpreted, replaced, bypassed or contradicted by downstream architecture or implementation.
Where the architecture does not establish a fact, relationship, responsibility or decision, that absence SHALL be preserved explicitly rather than completed through inference, convention, structural convenience, lexical similarity or anticipated implementation.
Unresolved architecture MAY be accompanied by clearly identified candidates, suggestions or recommendations, but these SHALL remain explicitly non-authoritative until explicitly accepted into the architecture.
Where evidence indicates that authoritative architecture may be incorrect, incomplete or internally inconsistent, the conflict SHALL be raised explicitly for architectural review. The existing architecture remains authoritative until an approved architectural change is made. That approved change becomes the new authoritative architecture.
#### Rationale
Downstream derivation must distinguish established architectural knowledge from gaps and proposed resolutions. A plausible relationship supplies no authority merely because it makes a model or implementation appear complete. Absence of an established relationship is architecturally meaningful information.
Repeated architectural review during Domain04 Package2 G1 confirmed this need across different traceability relationships:
- K9: unresolved Capability hierarchy must not be completed through invented ancestry. - K10: Behaviour / Process traceability must not be completed through invented stage equivalence. - K11: Function / Service traceability must not be completed through unsupported Feature association. - K12: cross-capability dependency traceability must not be completed through invented Service ownership or consumption. - K13: downstream representation traceability must not be completed through anticipated FHIR, application or technology mappings.
These examples justify an architecture-wide rule; its application does not depend on Domain04 or G1 terminology.
#### Consequences
Human architects, human developers and AI development agents SHALL apply this axiom to architecture derivation, documentation generation and implementation.
Architectural traceability SHALL represent established relationships and explicitly preserve unresolved or unestablished relationships. Completeness SHALL NOT be manufactured through:
- inferred hierarchy; - structural convenience; - lexical similarity; - conventional modelling patterns; - assumed equivalence; - anticipated implementation; - familiar standards; - probable application design.
Candidates, suggestions and recommendations SHALL be distinguishable from documented, approved architecture. A proposed resolution or apparently better alternative SHALL NOT acquire authority through downstream use.
AI development agents SHOULD challenge architecture when evidence warrants architectural review. They SHALL NOT silently bypass it because they recognise a familiar destination.
This axiom applies the authority and explicit-review obligations in [Purpose](../../../../../docs/markdown/governance/architectural-axioms.md#1-purpose), [Relationship to Architecture Decisions](../../../../../docs/markdown/governance/architectural-axioms.md#6-relationship-to-architecture-decisions) and [Architectural Review Rule](../../../../../docs/markdown/governance/architectural-axioms.md#7-architectural-review-rule) to downstream derivation and implementation.
[AX-14](../d3fc6025dc7646d1b2020b51f7a44bfa.md) preserves semantic distinctions; this axiom preserves the distinction between established, unresolved and proposed architecture. [AX-15](../ef8abbaec37e4890ad78b9f263e67906.md) governs uncertainty about operational state, outcome or effect; this axiom governs uncertainty about the architecture itself. Neither form of uncertainty may be silently resolved by assumption.
[AX-02](../eee8c3783d964d18a7f9dcea85fcd4cf.md) and [AX-04](../54508cda80484a6caf95b901780eaf7d.md) preserve Harmonia's internal semantics from external standards and engine assumptions. Familiar standards or technology patterns do not establish otherwise undocumented architectural relationships. [AX-06](../952c3b6148ce4fce94b69f99a0c2fec7.md) governs the authority of managed information; architectural authority remains a distinct concern.
#### Maxim
**Traceability must be truthful, not artificially complete.**

Additional Feature responsibility: FEAT-HSO-06 — Perioperative Resource Notification is realised by dispatching progression-triggered alerts to portering, sterilisation and recovery teams within this same case-progression behaviour/exposure. Milestone observation alone does not establish notification; no new Function or Service is created.

element.name: [CT2] Clinical Quality Management
element.documentation:
Manage the clinical-quality distinctions materially required for R1/R2.
Clinical Quality Management supplies the criteria and evidence basis for evaluating clinical quality and communicating established findings. Its four children preserve the difference between the expected standard, the material considered, the assessment reached and the report of that assessment. This supports scrutiny of why a quality conclusion is justified rather than treating the presence of measurements as a judgement.
**Intent**
Make clinical-quality conclusions understandable in relation to their criteria, evidence and assessment authority.
**Boundary**
Reporting does not originate the conclusion or perform subsequent improvement. Neither a separate monitoring provider nor generic Continuous Improvement placement is established by this decomposition.
## ARB identity continuity
Historical identity [dc1bece79eb7452e951d03a2ee6dfaa6](dc1bece79eb7452e951d03a2ee6dfaa6.md) has direct correspondence with this capability under HCRL 1.1.5-002. Historical provenance and UUID reservation remain with that record; this resource retains its existing identity and independent standing.
## Capability model replacement history

Correspondence does not assert complete semantic equivalence, implementation satisfaction or transfer domain authority.
